source_snapshot.procedure: Verify recipe; source requests log clearing; run NVQual Test #3; collect results/photos and inspect post-test logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: All items should be passed without system hang or reboot.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 5 attended and 15 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; identifies NVIDIA tooling but proposes generic link/device evidence rather than a bandwidth measurement.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; held Pending for exact workload/path/direction/duration, raw byte/time samples, threshold/tolerance, iterations/control scope and recovery.

old_problem: Negotiated PCIe generation/width is theoretical capacity, not measured throughput. The direction/memory domain, topology/NUMA placement, buffers/concurrency, warmup, timed population, raw bytes, aggregation and signed threshold were unspecified; clearing logs would remove evidence.
disposition_reason: The bandwidth objective is measurable from raw transferred bytes and time under a pinned workload. Exact Test #3 manifest, topology, direction/workload plan and project limit can be runtime configuration. The review is complete, but PASS remains unavailable until threshold/tolerance and all measurement semantics are signed.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2126, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2127 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00004-V002 / 3d3029ba0a720888 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind the pinned NVQual Test #3 bandwidth manifest, exact host/root-port/switch/retimer/GPU path, stable identities, NUMA node and source/destination memory domains.
Define every required transfer direction, payload/buffer size, concurrency, warmup, sample duration, repetitions, units, competing-load policy and generation/width baseline.

Retain immutable raw bytes and high-resolution timestamps/durations per sample so throughput can be independently recalculated; report distribution and the approved aggregate rather than only vendor PASS.
Preserve/hash existing logs instead of clearing them; correlate each sample with link, inventory, NUMA/CPU placement, thermal/power/throttling and error state.
No PASS is permitted until signed threshold/tolerance and aggregation exist. A short 5/15-minute estimate must not replace a longer project-required performance run.

Do not invent reset/power actions; if separately required by the vendor manifest, authorize exact semantics. Stop on first below-limit result with health fault, downtrain, device loss, hang/reboot, limit breach, evidence gap or tool fault without retry.
No NVQual/bandwidth load, topology/link query, log clearing, reset, power cycle, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Raw-sample-reproducible HGX NVQual Test #3 PCIe bandwidth qualification
test_case.purpose: Measure every approved PCIe transfer direction on the mapped HGX path with a pinned workload and prove raw-sample throughput meets the signed project threshold while links, devices and platform health remain stable.
required_package: Pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #3 bandwidth package/configuration with compatible firmware/driver
Approved direction, payload/buffer, concurrency, warmup, timed sample, repetitions and competing-load plan
Raw byte/time calculation, units, aggregation and signed threshold/tolerance
Dedicated idle HGX SUT, immutable evidence store, console, stable cooling/power and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration and bandwidth limits are signed. Export/hash baseline topology, logs and inventories; after point approval run only the pinned Test #3 direction/workload/sample matrix. Preserve raw transferred bytes and high-resolution timing for every sample, independently calculate throughput, compare with the signed threshold/tolerance, and correlate link/device/NUMA/thermal/power/error state. Stop on first performance/health or evidence anomaly; do not extend or retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every required direction/sample has traceable raw byte/time data, correct topology/NUMA placement and calculated throughput satisfying the signed threshold/tolerance/aggregation, with required link and device identities intact, no hang or unplanned reboot/reset, no disqualifying error and approved final health.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until workload, formula/units, aggregation and threshold/tolerance are approved. PASS then requires every required sample/direction and aggregate to satisfy the signed contract with complete health evidence. FAIL on below-limit result, invalid placement/timing, downtrain/device loss, hang/reboot, disqualifying error or failed recovery. Missing input/threshold/artifact is BLOCKED; retry cannot erase failure.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact Test #3 recipe/topology/workload, raw measurement, threshold/tolerance, sample policy and recovery are signed.
Preserve baseline evidence; link width alone is never bandwidth proof.
Use an isolated SUT with stable cooling/power and authorize any separate reset/power boundary explicitly.
Stop without load extension, evidence clearing or retry on first performance, platform or artifact anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner-approved Test #3 manifest/configuration and authorization
HGX/tool/firmware/driver identities plus complete path/NUMA/memory-domain map
Raw per-sample bytes, start/end timestamps/durations, recalculated throughput, distribution/aggregate and threshold result
Per-sample link/device inventory, CPU/NUMA placement, AER/kernel/GPU/BMC/thermal/power artifacts
First-fault/recovery or clean final device/link/host state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On below-limit sample with health anomaly, invalid placement/timing, downtrain, device loss, hang/reboot, disqualifying error or artifact gap, inhibit later samples and preserve the first event. Do not alter duration or rerun before evidence is secured; follow signed recovery and quarantine if device/topology/health is not restored.

source_conflict.reason: Items and Test #3 identify PCIe bandwidth; generic Criteria is under-specified but does not conflict with that objective.

blocked.reason: Review-layer measurement is complete. Runtime remains BLOCKED until workload, raw calculation and signed threshold/tolerance are bound.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Pinned Test #3 recipe, topology/NUMA/memory domains, direction/workload/warmup/sample/repetition plan, raw formula/units/aggregation, signed threshold/tolerance, control scope and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; PARAMETERIZED PCIE BANDWIDTH GATE CLOSED; NO NVQUAL/BANDWIDTH LOAD, TOPOLOGY/LINK QUERY, LOG CLEAR, RESET, POWER CYCLE, RECOVERY, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: HGX/NVIDIA qualification, PCIe performance and project specification owners
pending.unlock_condition: Bind all inputs including signed bandwidth threshold/tolerance and receive point authorization; without them execution remains BLOCKED and cannot PASS.

external_authorities.application: Requires command-purpose fit, raw quantitative evidence and approved threshold, preserves formal duration/coverage, logs and no-retry behavior.

project_authority: NVIDIA/performance owner supplies Test #3 workload/measurement; project owner signs threshold/tolerance; platform owner binds topology/recovery; engineer owns verdict.
